description: The SCOTT sample schema (dept, emp, salgrade, bonus, pet) as loaded by the query compliance cases of Apache Ossie. Values are those of the SCOTT tables in Apache Calcite, with the bonuses and pets of Ossie.

attributes.comment: Name of the employee who got the bonus.
attributes.label: Employee Name
attributes.name: ename

attributes.comment: Amount of the bonus, in commission.
attributes.label: Bonus
attributes.name: comm

entities.description: Bonus of an employee: three rows, two for JONES and one for KING.
entities.label: bonus
entities.name: bonus

entities.description: Department of the company; the four rows of the SCOTT sample.
entities.label: dept
entities.name: dept

attributes.comment: Employee number of the manager; blank for the president.
attributes.label: Manager
attributes.name: mgr

attributes.comment: Commission; blank for employees who get none, zero is a commission of zero.
attributes.label: Commission
attributes.name: comm

entities.description: Employee of the company, with manager and department.
entities.label: emp
entities.name: emp

attributes.comment: Primary key of the pet: its name.
attributes.label: Pet Name
attributes.name: pname

attributes.comment: Employee number of the owner; blank for TRAMP, who has none.
attributes.label: Owner
attributes.name: empno

attributes.comment: Species of the pet: CAT, DOG or HAMSTER.
attributes.label: Species
attributes.name: species

attributes.comment: Age of the pet in years.
attributes.label: Age
attributes.name: age

entities.description: Pet of an employee, with species and age; eight rows, one of them without an owner.
entities.label: pet
entities.name: pet

attributes.comment: Primary key of the salary grade.
attributes.label: Grade
attributes.name: grade

entities.description: Salary range of a grade. It is joined to emp by a range (sal between losal and hisal), not by a key, so it has no relation.
entities.label: salgrade
entities.name: salgrade

label: scott
name: scott

links.description: Joins emp to emp: the employee and the manager are two aliases of emp.
links.label: manager
links.name: same_manager

links.description: Joins emp to salgrade: not by a key, by the range of the grade -- the salary lies between its losal and hisal. An employee matches one grade, a grade many employees.
links.label: salary grade
links.name: same_grade

links.description: Joins bonus to emp by the name of the employee. An employee may have several bonuses.
links.label: employee
links.name: same_employee

links.description: Joins pet to emp. An employee may have several pets, a pet has at most one owner: TRAMP has none.
links.label: owner
links.name: same_owner
